race.comment: FIERCE FIGHTER (2) resumes as the runner with the most appealing overall profile, having placed twice last prep down in Victoria. The 1110m record is a query, but two trials and a 2kg claim give him a solid platform for the new stable. DOMINATOR (1) is the obvious danger after being beaten a nose at Beaudesert as a well-supported favourite before the break. A close trial here on the Inner Track trial suggests he is forward enough to fire fresh. ON THE CUSP (6) was slow away and still charged home to miss by 2L here first-up, which keeps her right in the contest second-up. ENTERPRISE JAMAYKA (8) has been moderate in two Ipswich runs, but first-time blinkers can sharpen her right up. Not dismissing.
